name: Legacy generate endpoint and per-request provider override
description: The legacy POST /api/v1/campaign/generate returns a full workflow response; the X-LLM-Provider header selects a provider from the catalog, and an unknown provider is rejected as a clean 400, not a 500.

planSteps.description: GET {base_url}/api/v1/llm/providers and capture the provider_id of the entry whose is_default is true.

POST {base_url}/api/v1/campaign/generate with header X-LLM-Provider set to the captured default provider_id and JSON body {"product_name":"ReelMatrix","product_description":"An AI marketing copilot that co-creates strategy and drafts content.","target_audience":"Marketing leads at small teams","marketing_goal":"Awareness and signups","user_prompt":"Draft a launch campaign."}.

Verify the response is 200 with a JSON body containing 'status' (one of 'needs_more_ideation' or 'plan_generated') and an 'ideation_result'; when status is 'plan_generated' a non-null 'campaign_plan' is present, and when status is 'needs_more_ideation' 'campaign_plan' is null.
POST {base_url}/api/v1/campaign/generate with header X-LLM-Provider set to an unknown value such as 'not-a-real-provider' and the same valid JSON body as above.
Verify the response is a 400 with a JSON error detail (provider selection error), not a 5xx.
